text:
Danielle Kim: Hi everyone 44b First day and small emergency: my desk kit arrived but (1) the monitor arrived without any VESA screws so I can't mount it to the arm, (2) the USB-C dock charges my laptop but the external display stays black even though Windows shows a second monitor in Display Settings, and (3) trying to join corp-secure wifi (802.1X) gives 'EAP authentication failed' after I sign in via SSO. Who do I ping for fast help?

Rory - IT: Welcome Danielle! Sorry about the scramble. Which OS are you on? Quick triage: try direct-connecting monitor to laptop HDMI to confirm panel works, and if on Windows check Device Manager for DisplayLink or vendor hub drivers. I can open a ticket if you'd like.

Danielle Kim: I'm on Windows 11 company image. Direct HDMI to laptop works fine. When connected to the dock Windows Detects a second display (shows in Settings) but the panel stays totally black.

Rory - IT: That usually means the dock enumerates the display but doesn't complete the DP/HDMI handshake. Quick checks: 1) In Device Manager > Monitors, any unknown monitor entries? 2) In Device Manager > Universal Serial Bus controllers, any entries like "DisplayLink USB" or vendor names (e.g., BrixTech, ASMedia)? 3) Try a different USB-C port and a power cycle of the dock. Also running this PowerShell helps to list USB devices:
```powershell
Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object {$_.Class -like '*USB*'} | Select-Object FriendlyName, Status
```

Danielle Kim: Device Manager shows "Generic USB Hub" and "ASIX AX88179 USB 3.0 to Gigabit Ethernet". No DisplayLink entry. I power-cycled the dock and swapped laptop ports, same behavior.

Rory - IT: Got it. I've opened ticket IT-358888 and added your notes. Two immediate actions: I'll queue a remote vendor driver push for the dock this afternoon; if that doesn't fix it we'll swap the dock. Second, I'll request a VESA screw kit shipped and a spare DisplayPort cable. Hector, can you handle parts?

Hector (Logistics): On it 69a I've placed order: VESA M4 x 10 kit + DP cable + spare USB-C dock. Shipping under IT-358888, ETA next business day. Tracking will be posted to the ticket.

Danielle Kim: Thanks Hector. For the Wi-Fi, same symptom as others: it prompts for my work email, I SSO, MFA, then Wi-Fi says 'EAP authentication failed'. Any quick workaround?

Rory - IT: EAP failures often mean a stale 802.1X profile or a certificate in the Credential Manager/Keychain. On Windows try: Control Panel -> Credential Manager -> Windows Credentials and remove any corp-related saved network creds, then reboot and attempt join. If you're short on time I can issue a one-hour wired token so you can get online for onboarding. Need it now?

Danielle Kim: Yes please the wired token would be very helpful. My onboarding call is in 20 minutes.

Rory - IT: Done 4aa I issued a one-hour wired token and DM'ed it to you. Also scheduled the remote driver push at 15:30 PT under IT-358888. If the push fails we'll pre-stage a dock swap.

it-bot: [IT-358888] Status: "VESA screws + DP cable ordered. Remote driver push scheduled 15:30 PT. One-hour wired token issued to reporter." Ticket owner: Rory - IT.

Ava (Facilities): Danielle, I can drop a small hardware bag with screws and an allen key at your desk this afternoon. Which desk are you at?

Danielle Kim: Desk D-14, that would be amazing, thanks Ava.

Hector (Logistics): Quick follow-up: I've reserved a spare dock for same-floor swap if the driver push doesn't resolve the issue. Will update tracking by EOD.

Danielle Kim: Received the wired token and joined the onboarding call. Thanks everyone! Will report back after the 15:30 driver push.

Rory - IT: Great. If anyone else on the fleet hits DP-present-but-black symptoms with DockModel-Brix-UI mention IT-358888 so we can correlate. Danielle, reply here after the driver push and we'll either schedule a hardware swap or close the ticket. :thumbsup:
